title: PLeDO: Pain Level Detection for Osteoarthritis from EMR Data
abstract: arXiv:2608.15719v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Osteoarthritis (OA) is a progressive chronic joint disease resulting in a breakdown of articular cartilage and bone when damaged joint tissues are not able to normally repair themselves. The aim of this pilot research study is to understand the pain severity for OA from patients' primary care Electronic Medical Records (EMR), both from the structured medical data and the unstructured chart note data using information extraction, natural language processing and machine learning techniques. We propose SPaDe, a Synonym-based Pain level Detection tool to categorize patients into having mild or moderate-to-severe pain to understand diagnosis and treatment methods based on only the pain related expressions in the unstructured chart note. translated_title: PLeDO：基于电子病历数据的骨关节炎疼痛程度检测
translated_abstract: 骨关节炎（OA）是一种进行性慢性关节疾病，当受损的关节组织无法正常自我修复时，会导致关节软骨和骨骼的破坏。本初步研究旨在通过患者的初级保健电子病历（EMR）数据，包括结构化医疗数据和非结构化病历记录，利用信息提取、自然语言处理和机器学习技术，理解OA患者的疼痛严重程度。我们提出了SPaDe，一种基于同义词的疼痛程度检测工具，仅根据非结构化病历记录中的疼痛相关表达，将患者分类为轻度或中度至重度疼痛，以了解诊断和治疗方法。这些表达具有主观性、客观性，并受文化背景和人口统计学影响，这构成了一个困难的挑战。因此，我们通过整合来自t的用药信息来改进模型。
tldr: 本研究提出SPaDe工具，利用电子病历中的非结构化文本和药物信息，通过自然语言处理技术自动检测骨关节炎患者的疼痛严重程度，以支持临床诊断和治疗决策。
en_tdlr: This study proposes SPaDe, a tool that leverages unstructured EMR text and medication information with NLP techniques to automatically detect pain severity in osteoarthritis patients, supporting clinical diagnosis and treatment decisions.
